name: xyz.quantumatlas/x402-payment-hub
title: Quantum Atlas Stripe X402 Agent Payment Hub
description: Stripe-powered HTTP 402 agent payment hub: spend keys, subagent caps, approvals & 25+ paid tools.

tools.name: x402_list_capabilities
tools.description:
Browse priced HTTP 402 capabilities, USD rates, input schemas, and example arguments. Use this first to find capability_id values; do not use for dry-runs (x402_preview_capability), ledger probes (x402_check_health), or multi-item pricing (x402_quote_plan).
Parameters: omit filters for all items, or pass lane / capability_id (accepts ID, route key, or path); combining both intersects them.
Behavior: no auth, zero charge; returns one unpaginated payload (~25 capabilities, 5 lanes), cached 30s.

lane.description: Optional capability lane filter: live_data (maritime/harbor/parking oracles), studio_audio (GPU stem separation), switchboard (11-language voice/broadcast), member_tools (KB/co-creation), or live_broadcast.

capability_id.description: Optional specific capability_id or route key to inspect (e.g. "reality_harbor_state", "audio_visual_isolate", or "POST /switchboard/chunk") when retrieving its exact input_schema and example_arguments without loading all 25 capabilities.

tools.name: x402_check_health
tools.description:
Probe live readiness of the Stripe X402 Payment Hub and its backing Stripe credit ledger. Use this before autonomous workflows or when diagnosing 503 errors; do not use this to browse rates (use x402_list_capabilities) or read an account balance (use x402_get_account).
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, no-store; typically responds in <1s and enforces an 8s ledger timeout before failing closed with HTTP 503.

tools.name: x402_preview_capability
tools.description:
Dry-run any priced HTTP 402 capability against deterministic sandbox fixtures with real input validation and live production pricing. Use this to test schemas at zero cost before funding; do not use for live data (x402_execute_capability) or multi-item quotes (x402_quote_plan).
Parameters: omit arguments to auto-fill valid example defaults, or supply custom arguments to test real contract validation.
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, zero GPU compute; returns sandbox=true fixture, HTTP 422 on invalid args, HTTP 404 on unknown capability, 120 req/min/IP.

capability_id.description: Priced capability_id or route key from x402_list_capabilities to dry-run (e.g. "reality_harbor_state", "kb_search", or "POST /switchboard/chunk").

arguments.description: Optional JSON arguments matching the capability input_schema. Omit to auto-fill valid example defaults; pass custom fields to verify 422 validation.

tools.name: x402_quote_plan
tools.description:
Price 1 to 25 HTTP 402 capabilities and optionally check balance, freeze state, and cumulative delegate caps. Use this before executing to verify total cost or detect approval/top-up needs; do not use to browse schemas (x402_list_capabilities), dry-run (x402_preview_capability), or execute (x402_execute_capability).
Parameters: omit spend_key and x-atlas-spend-key header for pricing only; supply either (mismatch -> HTTP 400) for policy evaluation.
Behavior: zero charge; HTTP 401 invalid key, HTTP 404 unknown capability, HTTP 503 ledger down, 120 req/min/IP.

capability_id.description: Capability identifier or route key from x402_list_capabilities (e.g. "reality_harbor_state", "audio_visual_isolate", "POST /switchboard/chunk", or "/kb/search").

quantity.description: Integer number of calls to quote for this capability (1 to 1000; defaults to 1).

order.description: Optional request payload required only for dynamically quoted routes such as POST /switchboard/chunk (e.g. {"text": "Hello harbor.", "languages": ["es-US", "ja-JP"]}).

items.description: One priced capability line item to include in the quote calculation.
Ordered list of 1 to 25 capability line items to price and policy-check together.

spend_key.description: Stripe-funded master or delegated subagent spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Optional when the caller supplies the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

tools.name: x402_execute_capability
tools.description:
Execute one live HTTP 402 capability, debiting prepaid Stripe USD credit and returning upstream output with receipt and Ed25519 attestation. Use this after verifying schemas and cost; do not use for free dry-runs (x402_preview_capability) or pricing (x402_quote_plan).
Parameters: supply spend_key or x-atlas-spend-key header (mismatch -> HTTP 400); pass flat fields or nested order for dynamic routes; reuse idempotency_key on retries.
Behavior: debits credit; upstream HTTP >= 400 auto-refunds 100% and restores delegate caps. HTTP 401/402/403 auth/balance/freeze/cap, 404 unknown, 409 idempotency conflict.

capability_id.description: Priced capability identifier or route from x402_list_capabilities to execute (e.g. "reality_harbor_state", "kb_search", or "POST /switchboard/chunk").

arguments.description: JSON input arguments expected by the target capability (e.g. {"destination": "annapolis"} for reality_harbor_state or {"query": "city dock"} for kb_search).

max_spend_cents.description: Hard client-side spend ceiling in USD cents (e.g. 50 = $0.50). If the live capability price exceeds this value, execution aborts with HTTP 403 before any debit occurs.

idempotency_key.description: Stripe-standard idempotency key (8-128 chars, e.g. "run-2026-11-22-harbor-01") ensuring retries reuse the exact original reservation without double-charging.

approval_id.description: Single-use human spend escalation approval ticket identifier returned by x402_request_approval (format: sba_<16 hex chars>, e.g. sba_aabbccddeeff0011).

spend_key.description: Stripe-funded master or delegated subagent spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Optional when the caller supplies the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

tools.name: x402_get_account
tools.description:
Read live Stripe X402 account status: balance, freeze state, pending checkouts, approvals, and recent orders. Use this for a full account overview; do not use to filter delegated keys alone (x402_list_delegate_keys), export statements (x402_export_statement), or quote calls (x402_quote_plan).
Parameters: supply spend_key or x-atlas-spend-key header (mismatch -> HTTP 400); master sees all state, delegate sees own scope.
Behavior: zero charge; master reads poll open Stripe checkouts so settled top-ups appear immediately. HTTP 401 invalid/revoked key, 120 req/min/IP.

spend_key.description: Stripe-funded master or delegated subagent spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Optional when the caller supplies the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

tools.name: x402_create_checkout
tools.description:
Create a hosted Stripe Checkout session ($10-$500 USD, zero crypto) to fund a new or existing master spend key. Use this to provision or top up an account; do not use to check balances (x402_get_account) or mint subagent keys (x402_issue_delegate_key).
Parameters: omit spend_key/header to create a new master account (returns one-time spend_key), or pass an existing master key to top up (mismatch -> HTTP 400).
Behavior: uncharged until paid (~4s credit); 31-min expiry; retries open new sessions. Max 3 open unpaid/account (HTTP 409 checkout_already_open returns error only, no prior URLs); 30/min global; HTTP 403 for delegates.

amount_cents.description: Prepaid Stripe credit pack size in USD cents: 1000 ($10), 2500 ($25), 10000 ($100), 25000 ($250), or 50000 ($500).

return_surface.description: Web console surface to redirect the operator to after Stripe Checkout finishes: "x402" (default, quantumatlas.xyz/x402/), "developers", or "app".

spend_key.description: Master Stripe account spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Delegated subagent keys are rejected with HTTP 403. Optional if supplied via the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

tools.name: x402_list_delegate_keys
tools.description:
List delegated subagent spend keys (sbd_*) with caps, route allowlists, expiration, and live spend usage. Use this to audit subagent keys or check the 50-active-key limit without loading orders; do not use for full account state (x402_get_account) or reconciliation (x402_export_statement).
Parameters: supply spend_key or x-atlas-spend-key header (mismatch -> HTTP 400); master sees all keys, delegate sees only itself.
Behavior: zero charge; returns one unpaginated list sorted newest-first (up to 50 active plus history), HTTP 401 invalid/revoked key, 120 req/min/IP.

status.description: Optional lifecycle status filter: "all" (default, every key), "active" (non-revoked and unexpired), "revoked", or "expired".

spend_key.description: Stripe-funded master or delegated subagent spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Optional when the caller supplies the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

tools.name: x402_issue_delegate_key
tools.description:
Mint a budget-capped, route-scoped, expiring delegated subagent spend key backed by your master account. Use this to provision a new subagent; do not use to list keys (x402_list_delegate_keys), edit caps (x402_update_delegate_key), or revoke keys (x402_revoke_delegate_key).
Parameters: supply master spend_key or x-atlas-spend-key header (mismatch -> HTTP 400); omitted caps remain unlimited up to master balance.
Behavior: non-idempotent — check x402_list_delegate_keys before retrying timeouts. Plaintext spend_key is shown once; limit 50 active keys/account (HTTP 429), HTTP 403 for delegates, 120 req/min/IP.

label.description: Human-readable label identifying the subagent or workflow (1-80 chars, e.g. "harbor-monitor-agent").

agent_id.description: Optional stable machine agent identifier recorded on spend audit rows (e.g. "agent.cursor.prod-01").

max_order_cents.description: Maximum USD cents allowed on any single capability call (e.g. 50 = $0.50). Omit for no per-call limit.

daily_budget_cents.description: Rolling UTC-day spend cap in USD cents (e.g. 500 = $5.00/day). Omit for no daily cap.

total_budget_cents.description: Lifetime cumulative spend cap in USD cents across the key lifespan (e.g. 2500 = $25.00 total). Omit for no lifetime cap.

allowed_routes.description: Route allowlist patterns restricting which capabilities the delegated key may invoke (supports exact routes like "POST /kb/search" or prefix wildcards like "GET /reality/*"). Omit or pass [] to allow all hub capabilities.

ttl_hours.description: Key expiration window in hours from issuance (1 to 8760 hours = 1 year; defaults to 168 hours = 7 days when omitted).

spend_key.description: Master Stripe account spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Delegated subagent keys are rejected with HTTP 403. Optional if supplied via the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

tools.name: x402_update_delegate_key
tools.description:
Modify standing spend caps, route allowlist, or label on an active delegated key without rotating its secret. Use this to adjust ongoing budgets; do not use to mint keys (x402_issue_delegate_key), approve one-time exceptions (x402_decide_approval), or disable keys (x402_revoke_delegate_key).
Parameters: omitted fields stay unchanged, null clears a cap, allowed_routes=[] permits all routes; supply master spend_key/header (mismatch -> HTTP 400).
Behavior: takes effect immediately without resetting usage counters; HTTP 403 delegates, HTTP 404 unknown, HTTP 401 revoked, 120 req/min/IP.

delegate_id.description: Unique delegated subagent key identifier returned by x402_issue_delegate_key or x402_get_account (format: sbd_<16 hex chars>, e.g. sbd_1122334455667788).

label.description: Updated human-readable label for the delegated subagent key.

max_order_cents.description: Updated per-call spend cap in USD cents, or null to clear the per-call cap.

daily_budget_cents.description: Updated UTC daily budget cap in USD cents, or null to clear the daily cap.

total_budget_cents.description: Updated lifetime cumulative cap in USD cents, or null to clear the lifetime cap.

allowed_routes.description: Route allowlist patterns restricting which capabilities the delegated key may invoke (supports exact routes like "POST /kb/search" or prefix wildcards like "GET /reality/*"). Omit or pass [] to allow all hub capabilities.

spend_key.description: Master Stripe account spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Delegated subagent keys are rejected with HTTP 403. Optional if supplied via the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

tools.name: x402_revoke_delegate_key
tools.description:
Permanently revoke one delegated key by delegate_id, or all active delegated keys when revoke_all=true. Use this to disable compromised or retired subagents; do not use for a temporary whole-account pause (x402_set_account_freeze) or cap edits (x402_update_delegate_key).
Parameters: pass delegate_id or revoke_all=true (revoke_all takes precedence if both set); supply master spend_key/header (mismatch -> HTTP 400).
Behavior: irreversible — revoked keys immediately fail HTTP 401. Safe to retry (already-revoked or 0 active return HTTP 200); HTTP 403 delegates, HTTP 404 unknown.

delegate_id.description: Unique delegated subagent key identifier returned by x402_issue_delegate_key or x402_get_account (format: sbd_<16 hex chars>, e.g. sbd_1122334455667788).

revoke_all.description: Set true to execute the emergency swarm kill switch revoking EVERY active delegated subagent key on the account (omit delegate_id when true).

reason.description: Optional audit-log reason recorded on swarm revocations when revoke_all=true (e.g. "key_rotated" or "compromised_worker").

spend_key.description: Master Stripe account spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Delegated subagent keys are rejected with HTTP 403. Optional if supplied via the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

tools.name: x402_request_approval
tools.description:
Open a pending single-use escalation ticket (sba_*) when a delegated subagent needs one-time permission beyond its standing caps or routes. Use this after x402_quote_plan flags human_approval_required=true; do not use to decide tickets (x402_decide_approval) or raise standing caps (x402_update_delegate_key).
Parameters: omit cents on fixed-SKU routes to auto-price, or pass cents for dynamic routes; supply spend_key/header (mismatch -> HTTP 400).
Behavior: zero charge; max 50 pending tickets/account (HTTP 429). Once approved, redeem in x402_execute_capability within 15 min; HTTP 401/404.

capability_id.description: Target capability_id or route key requiring one-time over-cap execution (e.g. "audio_visual_isolate" or "POST /audio/visual-isolate").

cents.description: Exact USD cent amount requested for approval (optional for fixed-SKU capabilities where the hub auto-resolves the exact price).

justification.description: Concise human-readable reason explaining why this one-time spend exception is required (shown to the operator in the /x402/ approval queue).

ttl_minutes.description: Minutes the pending ticket remains open awaiting operator decision (1 to 1440; defaults to 30 minutes when omitted).

spend_key.description: Stripe-funded master or delegated subagent spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Optional when the caller supplies the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

tools.name: x402_decide_approval
tools.description:
Approve once (15-min single-use pass bound to principal, route, and cent amount) or permanently deny a pending escalation ticket. Use this as master operator after checking x402_get_account; do not use to open tickets (x402_request_approval) or edit caps (x402_update_delegate_key).
Parameters: supply master spend_key or x-atlas-spend-key header (mismatch -> HTTP 400).
Behavior: final and irreversible (re-deciding returns HTTP 409 approval_not_pending). Approved passes consume atomically on first spend; HTTP 403 delegates, 404 missing, 410 expired.

approval_id.description: Single-use human spend escalation approval ticket identifier returned by x402_request_approval (format: sba_<16 hex chars>, e.g. sba_aabbccddeeff0011).

decision.description: Operator decision: "approve" grants a single-use 15-minute execution pass; "deny" permanently rejects the escalation ticket.

note.description: Optional operator audit note recorded as decision_note with the approval or denial decision.

spend_key.description: Master Stripe account spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Delegated subagent keys are rejected with HTTP 403. Optional if supplied via the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

tools.name: x402_set_account_freeze
tools.description:
Emergency kill switch halting or resuming all spends across master and delegated keys simultaneously. Use this during an incident to stop all spending while keeping keys intact; do not use to permanently revoke keys (x402_revoke_delegate_key).
Parameters: omitted reason defaults to "operator_freeze" on freeze and clears on unfreeze; supply master spend_key/header (mismatch -> HTTP 400).
Behavior: frozen accounts fail closed on all spends with HTTP 403 account_frozen while read-only tools stay active; call with frozen=false to resume. HTTP 403 delegates, 120 req/min/IP.

frozen.description: Set true to immediately halt all master and subagent spends across the account, or false to lift the freeze and resume spending.

reason.description: Optional incident or operator audit reason recorded on the account freeze state (e.g. "anomaly_investigation").

spend_key.description: Master Stripe account spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Delegated subagent keys are rejected with HTTP 403. Optional if supplied via the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

tools.name: x402_export_statement
tools.description:
Export a double-entry reconciled financial statement with SHA-256 checksum covering Stripe top-ups, spends, refunds, and delegate attribution. Use this for accounting audits and date-range reporting; do not use for live balances (x402_get_account) or active key caps (x402_list_delegate_keys).
Parameters: start_date/end_date are inclusive UTC filters (reconciliation spans full ledger); master may filter by delegate_id while delegates see own rows only; supply spend_key/header (mismatch -> HTTP 400).
Behavior: zero charge; HTTP 401 invalid/revoked key, 120 req/min/IP.

start_date.description: UTC calendar date in ISO-8601 YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2026-11-22).

end_date.description: UTC calendar date in ISO-8601 YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2026-11-22).

delegate_id.description: Unique delegated subagent key identifier returned by x402_issue_delegate_key or x402_get_account (format: sbd_<16 hex chars>, e.g. sbd_1122334455667788).

spend_key.description: Stripe-funded master or delegated subagent spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Optional when the caller supplies the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.
